extractedText: HomeMarket OutlookCommodities Global Agricultural Markets: Prudent Course Today Is To Establish Only Partial PositionsMay 22, 2026, 8:00 AM ETWheat Futures (W_1:COM), S_1:COM, C_1:COM, CT1:COM, KC1:COM, SB1:COM, JO1:COM, CC1:COMGRHAX, GRHIXGoehring & Rozencwajg Associates1.44K FollowersFollow5ShareSavePlay(9min)CommentsSummaryNearly 50% of all seaborne traded urea and roughly 25% of globally traded ammonia pass through the Strait of Hormuz, representing a position of considerable importance in the global fertilizer trade.Urea, whose seaborne trade routes were hit hardest by the closure of the Strait, surged 70%, while phosphate fertilizer rose 13% and potash declined 2% over the same period.The USDA now rates only 35% of this year's winter wheat crop as being in "good" condition, down from 47% a year ago, following the third driest period on record.The resulting disruption to global fertilizer supply has led Goehring & Rozencwajg to begin reaccumulating positions in fertilizer equities, which could perform well should grain prices emerge from their bear market.We believe the prudent course today is to establish only partial positions, with the intention of adding more aggressively should the El Niño arrive later than expected.
